heading: Sunday Night
text: Showers south petering off before dark, partial clearing northeast overnight. Fog, dense in the early morning. Lows in the low to mid 40s, near 40 in the cold spots. Winds reversing northerly overnight around 5 mph.

heading: Monday
text: Morning fog, dense in the northern Connecticut River lifting north to south through the morning to sunshine, until high clouds filter over the lower Greens. Highs from the upper 50s to low 60s, mid to upper 60s in the Lakes Region. North wind increasing to 5 to 10 mph east, west of the Green Mountains 10 north winds gusting to 20.

heading: Monday Night
text: Increasing clouds starting after dark, partly clear north. Slight chance of drizzle near Massachusetts. Lows from the upper 30s to mid 40s, few low 30s. Patchy frost in the mountains.
